observed_gap: WP807 currently has one baseline/intervention score per capability and aggregate success/action counts, but it lacks independently provenance-bound diagnostic dimensions for progress, grounding, regression and recovery. AgentBoard demonstrates that success alone can conceal meaningful intermediate behavior, yet its monotonic running-max progress also conceals regressions.
architecture_decision: NO_IMMEDIATE_SCHEMA_CHANGE_AT_E1. Preserve current WP807 fail-closed receipt-bound evaluator. Treat AgentBoard as a donor for measurement decomposition only. Promote a field/schema delta only after a sealed held-out discriminator proves that an orthogonal metric detects a failure mode that current score/delta/sample/success/action evidence cannot distinguish.

candidate_future_delta.design_constraint: Keep these values orthogonal and provenance-bound; do not silently collapse them into a single mean or let model self-report act as evaluator authority.

expected_benefit_if_promoted: Higher falsification power for agents that obtain similar final scores while differing in grounded action quality, regression behavior, recovery and resource efficiency.
resource_implication: Prefer integer/typed metric fields and deterministic aggregation over importing AgentBoard environments, W&B/dashboard, provider wrappers or a second benchmark runtime into F2.
counterhypothesis: Current upstream WP802-WP805 benchmark scores already encode all decision-relevant progress/recovery information; adding dimensions would only duplicate evidence and increase schema and evaluation cost.
falsifier: Construct a sealed paired trajectory/fixture set with equal current WP807 intervention_score_ppm, sample_count, success_count and action_count but different externally verified regression/recovery or grounding behavior. If no such pair changes the desired verdict, reject the proposed schema expansion.
